alignments.note: Anarthrous ἔπαινον is definite by its genitive modifiers.
'of the glory' renders the anarthrous genitive noun.
English replaces the article with the possessive 'his'.
'of' realizes the genitive; the possessive pronoun intervenes.
The relative attracted to χάριτος is the object of the English verb.
'he freely bestowed on' renders the single verb, including its subject and the English object preposition; 'on' could alternatively be attached to ἡμᾶς.
The substantival perfect participle is rendered by the single noun 'Beloved'.

review_notes: The apparatus reading ἐν ᾗ is not used: ASV's object relative 'which he freely bestowed' represents ἧς by attraction.
'on' is kept with the verb because English 'bestow' governs it; attaching it to ἡμᾶς instead would also be defensible.
